title: AI Tools Every Creator Must Try in 2026
description: AI tools every creator should try in 2026: DeepSeek, DALL·E, Runway, Jasper, ClickUp, Soundraw and Hemingway, and what each one is for.

blocks.v: Insights: Why AI is a Game-Changer for Creators

AI is no longer just an optional tool. It’s a necessity for creators who want to stay ahead of the competition. These advanced tools help automate repetitive tasks, generate high-quality content, and optimise workflows, allowing creators to focus more on innovation and storytelling. AI-powered solutions also reduce production costs, improve accuracy, and accelerate project completion times. From generating lifelike images to crafting compelling content, AI has the power to transform the creative process and open up new possibilities for artists, designers, and marketers alike.
Here are the must-try AI tools for every creator in 2026:
1. DeepSeek – The Ultimate Research Assistant
Research is the backbone of quality content, and DeepSeek is an AI-powered research tool that simplifies the process. It enables creators to:

v: Generate in-depth insights from academic papers, blogs, and articles.
Provide AI-driven summaries to quickly grasp complex topics.
Offer advanced keyword analysis to optimise content for search engines.

blocks.v: DeepSeek is perfect for bloggers, journalists, and content marketers who need accurate and efficient research to create compelling content.
2. DALL·E – AI Image Generation for Designers and Creators
Visuals play a crucial role in content marketing, and DALL·E by OpenAI has revolutionized image creation. It allows creators to:

v: Generate high-quality images based on text prompts.
Customise illustrations, graphics, and unique artwork.
Enhance creativity without requiring design expertise.

blocks.v: DALL·E is an essential tool for graphic designers, digital marketers, and social media influencers looking for unique, AI-generated visuals.
3. Runway – AI-Powered Video Editing and Creation
Video content is booming, and Runway is at the forefront of AI-driven video production. It provides:

v: Automated video editing with real-time AI assistance.
AI-generated visual effects and background removal.
Seamless text-to-video generation for content creators.

blocks.v: Runway is ideal for YouTubers, filmmakers, and social media marketers who want to create stunning videos without extensive editing skills.
4. Jasper AI – AI Content Writing Assistant
Content writing has never been easier with Jasper AI, an advanced writing assistant that helps creators generate:

v: High-quality blog posts, articles, and marketing copies.
AI-enhanced storytelling with natural language processing.
SEO-optimised content that ranks well on search engines.

blocks.v: Jasper AI is a game-changer for bloggers, marketers, and businesses that need compelling and engaging content quickly.
5. ClickUp – AI-Driven Productivity and Task Management
Managing projects efficiently is key to success, and ClickUp offers AI-powered productivity solutions, including:

v: Smart task automation to streamline workflow.
AI-powered writing assistance for quick note-taking.
Intelligent scheduling and deadline management.

blocks.v: ClickUp is perfect for freelancers, teams, and project managers looking to enhance productivity and collaboration.
6. Soundraw – AI Music Generator for Creators
Music production is no longer limited to experts. Soundraw enables creators to:

v: Generate royalty-free music based on mood and style.
Customise tracks for videos, podcasts, and advertisements.
Create high-quality background scores without extensive knowledge of music theory.

blocks.v: Soundraw is an excellent choice for content creators, YouTubers, and filmmakers who need original music for their projects.
7. Hemingway Editor – AI Grammar and Readability Checker
Writing effectively is crucial, and the Hemingway Editor ensures your content is clear and concise by:

v: Highlighting complex sentences and suggesting simpler alternatives.
Detecting grammar and punctuation errors.
Providing readability scores to enhance content engagement.

blocks.v: Hemingway Editor is a must-have for writers, bloggers, and content marketers aiming for crisp and impactful writing.
FAQs
1. Why should creators use AI tools in 2026?
AI tools enhance efficiency, automate tedious tasks, and help creators focus on creativity while maintaining high-quality outputs.
2. Which AI tool is best for video editing?
Runway is the best AI-powered tool for video editing, offering automated effects, background removal, and AI-driven editing features.
3. Can AI-generated content rank well on search engines?
Yes! With tools like Jasper AI and DeepSeek, creators can produce SEO-optimised content that ranks well in search engine results.
4. Are AI-generated images copyright-free?
DALL·E and similar tools generate unique images, but it’s important to check their licensing policies to ensure compliance.
5. How does AI improve productivity?
AI tools like ClickUp automate workflows, optimise scheduling, and provide smart task management to enhance efficiency.
Every tool and link in this article was opened and checked on 1 October 2026.
